title: 番外假如朔衡变成反派8番外假如朔衡变成反派7
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
几乎朔衡前脚刚回到凰天凝的住处，后脚她就回来了，
脸上的表情既复杂，又好似一切都在意料之中。
“恭喜你，朔道友。”凰天凝跟朔衡在前院站定，此地流芳水榭，别有一番风景，“残响雷纹螺…这宝物罕见，却也不是谁都能驾驭的。
唯有能与天雷共鸣之人才能降服此物，道友的天赋果然世所罕见。”
“多谢。”朔衡微微颔首，“这消息还要多亏凰道友告知于我，我才有幸得到此物。”
凰天凝笑着摇摇头：“有些东西是你的终会是你的。
哪怕今日我不说，或许明日这消息也要靠别的方法传进道友的耳朵里。”
“…姐姐！”
一到明丽的身影从后院蹦蹦哒哒的跑过来，结果一眼看到站在自家姐姐身边的青年时，她脚步顿时钉在原地、瞪大眼睛不动了。
“你…”
“原来是天玥道友，又见面了。”朔衡见到来者，也不好奇对方为什么会出现在这里。
凰天玥和凰天凝本就是亲姐妹，虽然妹妹的天赋不如姐姐，但姐姐身为圣女，庇护一下亲妹妹也理所当然，
“当日在灵膳坊的事，可真是记忆犹新。”
一个小丫头单枪匹马的在朝天城要掀了人家一间酒楼，实在是勇气可嘉。
虽说凤凰族是万族中的大族，
但归根结底，天怒界域还是朝天神宗说了算，
更何况凰天玥也没有优秀到凤凰族愿意为了她而得罪朝天神宗的地步。
好在芜仙不是个不讲理的人，没有太过追究对方的行为。
毕竟当初的事…也算是灵膳坊办事欠妥，当面挑衅。
“哼……是你！”

凰天玥没想给朔衡好脸色。
她可还记得朔衡是站在芜仙那边的，心里一直不痛快的很。
最不痛快的是，她后来把事情告诉长老，长老竟然也觉得是她的问题——说她不够成熟稳重，竟然直接在朝天城内当众闹事，丢了族中脸面。
所以就直接把她送回来了，对内称是闭门思过，实则就是不想让她继续留在那边添乱。
本来，凰天玥一定要随行，就是为了看自家姐姐在比武大会中的战场英姿，
结果比武没看成就算了，还喜提禁闭。
她见到朔衡能高兴就有鬼了！
“天玥，不得无礼。”
凰天凝无奈的伸手把凰天玥拉到身后，看向朔衡，“朔道友别见怪…”
“不见怪。”朔衡笑了笑，“凰道友能把这小丫头养的天真可爱，实属难得。
只可惜…在修仙界中，太过天真纯粹，或许刚过易折。”
凰天凝沉默半晌，缓缓点头：“…我明白。多谢。”
她只是觉得，她已经为凤凰族付出了所有，所以妹妹可以在她的庇护下快快乐乐的过一辈子。
不过上次的事也算是给她敲响了警钟。
凰天凝虽贵为圣女，但在凤凰族的话语权并不太高，这称号更类似于某种“吉祥物”存在，
真正把控凤凰族权力的，还是长老会的那批人。
content_en:
Almost as soon as Shuoheng returned to Huang Tianning's residence, she came back.
The expression on his face was complicated, but also as if everything was expected.
"Congratulations, fellow Taoist Shuo." Huang Tianning and Shuo Heng stood in the front yard, where the flowing water pavilion has a unique scenery, "Resounding Thunder Conch... This treasure is rare, but not everyone can control it.
Only those who can resonate with the thunder can subdue this thing. The talent of Taoist friends is indeed rare in the world. "
"Thank you very much." Shuo Heng nodded slightly, "Thanks to Fellow Taoist Huang who informed me of this news, I was lucky enough to get this thing."
Huang Tianning smiled and shook her head: "Some things that are yours will eventually be yours.
Even if I don't say it today, maybe tomorrow the news will reach the ears of fellow Taoists through other methods. "
"...sister!"
As soon as Mingli's figure came bounding from the backyard, and when she caught sight of the young man standing next to her sister, her steps immediately froze in place, her eyes widened and she stopped moving.
"You..."
"It turns out to be fellow Taoist Tianyue, we meet again." When Shuo Heng saw the visitor, he was not curious as to why he appeared here.
Huang Tianyue and Huang Tianning are biological sisters. Although the younger sister is not as talented as the elder sister, as a saint, it is natural for the elder sister to protect her biological sister.
"What happened at Lingshanfang that day is really fresh in my memory."
A little girl single-handedly destroyed a restaurant in Chaotian City. She was really brave.
Although the Phoenix Clan is the largest clan among all clans,
But in the final analysis, Chaotian Shenzong still has the final say in the realm of Heavenly Wrath.
What's more, Huang Tianyue is not so outstanding that the Phoenix Clan is willing to offend Chaotian Shenzong for her sake.
Fortunately, Wuxian was not an unreasonable person and did not pursue the other party's behavior too closely.
After all, what happened back then... could be regarded as Lingshanfang's improper handling and provocation in person.
"Hmph...it's you!"
Huang Tianyue didn't want to give Shuo Heng a good look.
She still remembered that Shuo Heng was on Wuxian's side, and she felt unhappy all the time.
The most unpleasant thing was that when she later told the elders about the matter, the elders actually thought it was her problem - saying that she was not mature enough and had caused trouble in public in Chaotian City, which had caused the clan to lose face.
So I sent her back directly, claiming internally that I was shutting myself away and thinking about my mistakes, but in fact, I just didn't want her to stay there and cause trouble.
Originally, Huang Tianyue had to accompany her just to see her sister's heroic appearance on the battlefield in the martial arts competition.
As a result, the competition did not focus on the results, and they even mentioned the confinement.
She was so happy to see Shuo Heng!
"Tian Yue, don't be rude."
Huang Tianning helplessly stretched out her hand to pull Huang Tianyue behind her and looked at Shuo Heng, "Friend Shuo Heng, don't be offended..."
"I'm not surprised." Shuo Heng smiled, "It's rare for Fellow Daoist Huang to be able to raise this little girl to be innocent and cute.
It's a pity... In the world of immortality, being too naive and pure may be just too easy to break. "
Huang Tianning was silent for a long time, then nodded slowly: "...I understand. Thank you."
She just felt that she had given everything for the Phoenix Clan, so her sister could live a happy life under her protection.
But what happened last time was a wake-up call for her.
Although Huang Tianning is a saint, she does not have a high say in the Phoenix clan. This title is more like a "mascot".
Those who really control the power of the Phoenix Clan are those from the Presbyterian Church.
